Service Requirements The Contractor must provide printing services, including the following tasks: • Graphic design and creation of annual report content for various Embassy offices. • Graphic design and creation of brochures, information portfolios, folders, advertising publications, flyers, and similar materials for the Embassy's promotional events. • Printing and/or photocopying of documents, brochures, and portfolios in a professional manner, ensuring clear colors, photographs, text, and images for finished products. Preference will be given to contractors offering multiple printing methods, such as commercial, digital, press, and web-based printing. • Supplying stock images for publications, as needed. • Providing printing designs for requesting offices to review and confirm prior to production. The Contractor is responsible for installing, setting up, and delivering printed items to U.S. Embassy Hanoi events. • Material Requirements: The Contractor shall present several material options for the Embassy's selection prior to submitting a quote. The Sizing Technology Pilot is a direct extension of this modernization mandate, seeking to apply advanced digital, computer vision, and AI-driven measurement extraction capabilities to a fundamental logistical process: Soldier and Cadet outfitting. The Army is exploring a Sizing Technology Pilot to modernize the Soldier and Cadet outfitting process by using body scanning, foot scanning, computer vision, and/or AI- driven measurement extraction to generate accurate measurements and translate them into recommended uniform and footwear sizing. This capability is intended to support personnel earlier in the accessions pipeline than is possible today, in support of a faster, more consistent, and more accurate issue experience. The scope of this requirement encompasses both body and foot scanning to modernize the issuance of both uniforms and footwear. insurance_bonds.text: EMENT OF OBJECTIVES (SOO) For Secure by-Design Space Vehicle (SDSV) Topic Area 3 1.0 Purpose The objective of this effort is to address cyber threats to national critical space missions (e.g., Position, Navigation, and Timing (PNT), Missile Warning/Missile Tracking (MW/MT), Intelligence, Surveillance, and Reconnaissance (ISR), and Satellite Communications (SATCOM)) through the research, design, development, testing, and demonstration of a comprehensive Secure by-Design Space Vehicle (SDSV) system. 2.0 Background Space vehicles are increasingly recognized as vulnerable platforms facing sophisticated cyber threats. To ensure mission assurance, there is a critical need to provide advanced defensive solutions for space assets. This project aims to reduce the attack surfaces of space vehicles and implement robust resiliency mechanisms that enable self-protection and rapid recovery from cyber anomalies, leveraging Cyber-Hardened Satellite Software (CHSS) technology. 3.0 Period and Place of Performance • Period of Performance: The anticipated period of performance is a 12-month Base effort, followed by three (3) 12-month Option periods, plus 3 months for final reporting (Total 51 Months). • Place of Performance: The work will be performed primarily at the contractors facilit

Pakkuja ja tellija lepivad kokku kooskõlastusringide tähtaegadest, vastutajatest ja kontaktisikutest. Ajakava koostamisel lähtutakse alljärgnevatest punktidest 5.3-5.11. Pakkuja töö hõlmab vähemalt järgmisi kooskõlastatud tööetappe: käsikirjade terviklik ülevaatus ja toimetamisvajaduse kaardistamine; ühe kooliastme klasside terminoloogia, struktuuri ja vormistuslahenduste ühtlustamine; kujunduskontseptsiooni ja näidiskülgede koostamine ning kooskõlastamine tellija ja autoritega; illustratsioonide, fotode, ikoonide ja muude visuaalsete elementide loomine või hankimine; esmane küljendus; katsetamise ja retsenseerimise tagasiside alusel muudatuste tegemine; lõplik keeleline ja tehniline korrektuur; trükifailide ettevalmistamine ja tellijapoolne kinnitamine enne trükki. Osades 1–3 kirjeldatud lõplike materjalide trükkimise eel viiakse läbi õppekomplektide katsetamine, milleks on vaja ette valmistada ja trükkida katsetuseksemplarid ja saata need katsetajatele.
